rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for picking particular people or things out of a larger group.

example.english: We cull a few applications from the pile first.
example.traditional: 我哋喺成堆申請表入面揀幾份出嚟先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 sing4 deoi1 san1 cing2 biu2 jap6 min6 gaan2 gei2 fan2 ceot1 lai4 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the meaning is gathering items or information into a collection rather than selecting or eliminating them.

example.english: The library cull old neighborhood stories from local residents.
example.traditional: 圖書館會收集街坊口述嘅舊區故事。
example.jyutping: tou4 syu1 gun2 wui5 sau1 zaap6 gaai1 fong1 hau2 seot6 ge3 gau6 keoi1 gu3 si6

rows.meaning: select and kill to reduce numbers
rows.note: Use this in population-management or breeding contexts for deliberately removing surplus or weak animals or plants to reduce the group.

example.english: Every year, we cull the weaker chickens on the farm.
example.traditional: 我哋每年都會淘汰農場入面啲唔夠健壯嘅雞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui6 tou4 taai3 nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 di1 m4 gau3 gin6 zong3 ge3 gai1
